name: Other armed conflicts
summary: Ethiopian forces take Sheraro in Tigray; Oromia–Somali clashes drive ~50,000 into Kenya; Afghan–Pakistan border fire
state: Ethiopian federal forces captured Sheraro in Tigray on 3 Nov and clashed with Tigrayan forces near Bizet, and imposed a curfew in Mekele on 5 Nov; Ethiopia–Eritrea tension persists, with Chinese envoys mediating 3–5 Nov (Critical Threats). Clashes between Ethiopia's Oromia and Somali regions have driven about 50,000 people into Kenya's Moyale since late October (UN News, 9 Nov). Pakistani media reported border fire with Afghan Taliban forces in Kurram on 5 Nov. No capital is under attack.
for_you: Fighting in northern and southern Ethiopia is displacing civilians. FCDO advises against travel to parts of Ethiopia and the Afghanistan–Pakistan border areas.
rubric_hit: Significant deterioration in conflicts not tracked elsewhere: Tigray offensive, Oromia–Somali clashes
